data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Oralla was believed to be a nymph living on a golden mountain. She symbolized prosperity, abundance, and protection. The name Oralla carries the meaning “Golden Mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Oralla usually hope their child will grow to embody golden mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Oralla total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian context, the name Oralla can be seen as a reference to God, who is the ultimate source of all prosperity and protection. It is a constant reminder of His presence in our lives, guiding us, providing for us, and protecting us from harm. Additionally, the name can inspire us to be like Oralla, being a source of abundance and protection for those around us. May we strive to live lives that reflect the abundance and protection that the name Oralla symbolizes, and may we always remember that it is God who is the true source of these blessings.
